expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while Home, Search and Profile all display an icon plus label. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab look broken/unrendered.
